component.name: Rec
component.summary: Record the screen, camera and audio

description.p: Rec is a fast, simple screen and camera recorder. It captures the screen, system audio and microphone on a single clock, composites an optional webcam overlay on the GPU, and writes a crash-safe movie with separate audio tracks. It is a Linux port of the macOS app rec-rs, with the same command line, settings and output format.

ul.li: Full display, single window or region capture through the desktop portal (Wayland and X11)
System audio and microphone as separate tracks plus a mix track
Webcam overlay in the upstream shapes (circle, rounded, square, pill, squircle) with border, shadow and mirroring
H.264, HEVC and ProRes output with an exact constant frame rate and 2-second crash-safe fragments
Pause and resume without drift, per-source gain, and a CLI that controls the running recorder
Live streaming to RTMP and WHIP destinations, and a replay buffer

description.p: The app is in the tray, and every action is also a command: run rec-rs --help or read the README for the headless recorder.

screenshot.caption: The recorder window: live preview, source picker, record controls and audio mixer
Settings: output folder, container, codec, resolution, audio and camera devices

description.p: Rec runs on Linux: screen, window and region capture through the desktop portals, system audio and microphone, V4L2 and portal cameras with the webcam overlay, the GPU compositor, the app window with preview and mixer, H.264/HEVC/ProRes recording with AAC and Opus, the replay buffer, RTMP and WHIP streaming, and Flatpak and AppImage packages.
